name: Ishibashi Yuuta
source:
He is a very erotic kid who is too interested in sex. He sneaks into his father's study, brings out pornographic videos hidden there, and watches them before breakfast.

 In fact, it is like watching a TV show during breakfast. He tries to test the erotic knowledge he has gained from the videos with his friends and Riko.
